sites.functional_impact_measured: Anti-FLAG immunofluorescence confirmed both total and surface expression of the FLAG-tagged full-length receptor in transfected cells.
sites.rationale: CMKLR1 has no endogenous signal peptide; its N-terminus (residue 1, M) is directly extracellular (EC1: residues 1–40), 40 residues from the TM1 boundary at residue 41, well exceeding the ≥3-residue clearance requirement. The TANGO construct (L5/L6) places a FLAG tag between an exogenous cleavable signal sequence and CMKLR1 residue 1, which is the only extracellular terminus of this 7-TM receptor, making insert_after_residue=0 the unique topology-derived junction. The same N-terminal FLAG arrangement is independently corroborated by two structural studies (L1/L2, L3/L4) expressing full-length membrane-anchored CMKLR1 in Sf9 insect cells. No residue number is named in any clip, so the position is topology-derived rather than validated. Full-length CMKLR1 TANGO construct in mammalian cells: exogenous cleavable signal sequence followed by FLAG epitope tag prepended before CMKLR1 residue 1, with the receptor expressed as a membrane-anchored protein on the cell surface.

sources.claim: In preliminary experiments, each TANGO-ized construct was transfected and then examined by anti-FLAG immunofluorescence for both total and surface expression ( Fig. 1b for examples).

literature_notes: All six ledger lines (L1–L6) converge on a single position: the N-terminal prepend (insert_after_residue=0). L1/L2 and L3/L4 (two independent structural papers, PMC10274904 and PMC10699647) describe full-length CMKLR1 with an exogenous signal peptide + FLAG + β2AR N-terminal fragment fused before CMKLR1 residue 1 in Sf9 insect cells; these are membrane-anchored constructs used for cryo-EM, not soluble ectodomains or Fc-fusions. L5/L6 (PMC4424118, TANGO paper) describe a mammalian-cell construct with cleavable signal sequence + FLAG before CMKLR1 residue 1, with surface expression confirmed by anti-FLAG immunofluorescence. Because all clips pin the same junction and no clip names a specific residue number, only one site is reported. The C-terminal 8×His tag (L1/L2) falls in IC4 (residues 320–373, intracellular) and is recorded in other_positions. No internal extracellular loop insertions are supported by the ledger.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal 8×His tag appended after residue 373 of full-length CMKLR1; the C-terminus falls in IC4 (residues 320–373, intracellular) and is not accessible on the extracellular face.
